geometric_setup.inner_product: <alpha,beta>_g = integral g^{ab} alpha_a beta_b sqrt(g) d^3x
geometric_setup.metric_variation: h_ab = delta g_ab, with conformal test slice h_ab = 2 q g_ab
geometric_setup.problem: Matrix elements and orthonormal bases change when the Hilbert metric changes; fixed-basis Gram traces are not final determinant coefficients.

hilbert_variation_formula.general_variation: delta <alpha,beta> = integral [(-h^{ab} + 1/2 tr_g(h) g^{ab}) alpha_a beta_b] dvol_g, plus basis/eigenform normalization terms if alpha,beta are moved with the metric
hilbert_variation_formula.conformal_slice_h_2qg_dimension3: delta <alpha,beta> = integral q g^{ab} alpha_a beta_b dvol_g for fixed one-form components in dimension 3
hilbert_variation_formula.normalization_warning: Even if the quotient basis is orthonormal at epsilon=0, its derivative contributes to first-order matrix elements and to self-adjoint reduced operators.
hilbert_variation_formula.trace_direction_warning: The trace/volume direction can mix with radius and gauge normalization; it cannot be tuned after seeing alpha.
hilbert_variation_formula.warning: This fixes the Hilbert-metric formula only. It is not yet the evaluated C_Hilb[1,3] matrix block or basis-renormalization correction.

must_report: basis/eigenform normalization correction or proof it vanishes in the chosen gauge
self-adjointness of the combined reduced operator under the varied inner product
whether Hilbert terms cancel, enlarge, or rotate the trace-80 image

current_obstruction_context.meaning: The trace-80 block was computed in the epsilon=0 quotient Hilbert metric. Hilbert variation tests whether the measuring stick itself changes the low-shell block.

pass_fail.meaning: The one-form inner-product variation is fixed at formula level.
C_Hilb[1,3] still must be evaluated in the explicit low-shell bases.
The derivative of orthonormal states or a gauge choice fixing it must be included before determinant traces are final.

plain_language: The fourth extinguisher is the ruler itself. When the metric changes, the way we measure one-form overlaps changes. The ruler formula is now written, but we have not yet remeasured the trace-80 fire with it.
verdict: The Hilbert inner-product variation is now fixed at formula level. For one-forms, delta<alpha,beta> = integral [(-h^{ab}+1/2 tr(h)g^{ab}) alpha_a beta_b] dvol, and in the conformal three-dimensional slice h=2qg this reduces to integral q <alpha,beta> dvol for fixed components. This advances the full-operator checklist but does not close C6; the required next output is the quotient-normalized n=1<->n=3 Hilbert/basis-normalization matrix contribution and a self-adjointness check.
